SELECT #{CATEGORY} AS CATEGORY , '' CODE , '선택' CODE_NAME , 0 SORT_NO UNION ALL
SELECT C.CATEGORY , C.CODE , C.CODE_NAME , C.SORT_NO FROM CODE_DTL C WHERE C.CATEGORY = #{CATEGORY} AND C.USING_YN = 'Y' AND C.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} ORDER BY SORT_NO ASC

SELECT '' CODE ,'선택' NAME ,'000' SORT_NO UNION ALL
SELECT C.DIVISION_CODE AS CODE ,C.DIVISION_NAME AS NAME ,DIVISION_CODE AS SORT_NO FROM PLANT C WHERE C.STATUS = 'Y' AND C.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} ORDER BY SORT_NO ASC

SELECT '' CODE ,'전체' NAME ,'000' SORT_NO UNION ALL SELECT CD.CODE AS CODE ,CASE #{default_language} WHEN 'KOR' THEN CD.CODE_NAME WHEN 'ENG' THEN CD.CODE_NAME_ENG ELSE CD.CODE_NAME_LOC END AS NAME ,SORT_NO AS SORT_NO FROM CODE_MST CM JOIN CODE_DTL CD ON CM.COMPANY_CODE = CD.COMPANY_CODE AND CM.CATEGORY = CD.CATEGORY WHERE CD.DELETE_YN = 'N' AND CM.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND CM.CATEGORY = #{category} ORDER BY SORT_NO ASC
